claim.claim-text: the reinforced aerogel composition is hydrophobic, having a liquid water uptake of 40 wt.% or less as measured according to ASTM C1511 or ASTM C1763; and the one or more aliphatic hydrophobic groups covalently bonded to at least some of the silicon of the silica-based framework have an onset of thermal decomposition of no less than 525°C.
2. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, wherein at least some of the one or more aliphatic hydrophobic groups comprise a methyl group.

3. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, wherein at least some of the one or more aliphatic hydrophobic groups covalently bonded to at least some of the silicon of the silica-based framework comprise methylsilyl groups.
4. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, wherein the silicon covalently bonded to the one or more aliphatic hydrophobic groups is trifunctional silicon or quadfunctional silicon.
5. The reinforced aerogel composition of claim 4, wherein:

the trifunctional silicon comprises T<1> species, T<2> species, and T<3> species in a relative proportion of T<1-2>:T<3> species of between about 0.1 and about 0.3; and the quadfunctional silicon comprises Q<2> species, Q<3> species, and Q<4> species in a relative proportion of Q<2-3>:Q<4> species of between about 0.1 and about 1.5.
6. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, wherein:

a weight proportion of the one or more aliphatic hydrophobic groups relative to a weight of the reinforced aerogel composition is a hydrophobic organic content; and the hydrophobic organic content of the reinforced aerogel composition is between about 1 wt.% and about 15 wt.%, preferably between 1 wt.% and about 10 wt.%, and more preferably between about 1 wt.% and about 5 wt.%.

7. The reinforced aerogel composition of claim 6, wherein the onset of thermal decomposition of the one or more aliphatic hydrophobic groups covalently bonded to at least some of the silicon bonded to the one or more aliphatic hydrophobic groups is 550°C or higher.
8. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, wherein the liquid water uptake is 20% or less.
9. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, further comprising an additive comprising silicon carbide.
10. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, wherein the reinforcement material comprises polymer fibers.
11. The reinforced aerogel composition of claim 10, wherein the polymer fibers comprise polyacrylonitrile fibers, oxidized polyacrylonitrile fibers, or combinations thereof.
12. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim having a thickness of 3 mm or less, preferably 2 mm or less, and more preferably 1 mm or less.
13. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, further comprising an opacifier additive.
14. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, further characterized by a resilience of more than 25%, preferably more than 50% according to ASTM C1101.
15. The reinforced aerogel composition of any preceding claim, further characterized by a flexibility of at least 5°, preferably at least 65° according to ASTM C1101.
